title: CLI argument parser misses the common flag forms
prompt: src/argv.js parses command-line arguments but only understands `--name value`, and it swallows the next token even when it is another flag. Rework parseArgv so it returns { _: positionals, flags } and supports `--name value`, `--name=value`, boolean `--verbose`, short `-v` and `-n 3`, and `--` to stop flag parsing. Do not edit the tests.
